decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 +0.1%) with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 threshold needed for a new position, so per past lessons we're holding all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ dipping 0.1% and the S&P 500 edging up 0.1%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts in the session. No major news source was provided for today's session, so this reflects only the price action data given. Quiet, low-volatility days like this often precede a bigger directional move once new information hits the market.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，納斯達克指數微跌0.1%，標普500指數則微升0.1%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。由於今日未提供具體新聞來源，此總結僅基於現有價格數據。這類低波動的觀望日子，往往是市場醞釀更大方向性走勢的前奏。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Holding cash instead of forcing a trade is itself a valid investment decision, not a failure to act. When available cash is too low to open a meaningful new position and the market isn't showing a strong signal, staying in cash preserves capital for a better opportunity later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 持有現金而非勉強交易，本身就是一種有效的投資決策，並非「無所作為」。當可用現金不足以建立有意義的新倉位，而市場又缺乏明確訊號時，保留現金是為了等待日後更好的入場機會。
